description: Registry of all Skills, consulted by the orchestrator (Agent 0) to decide which skill(s) a given pipeline step should load -- skill selection is a visible, explainable decision here, not a hardcoded association buried in agent prompts.

skills.name: pubmed-literature-search
skills.trigger_description: Use whenever an agent needs to search or retrieve biomedical literature -- PubMed corpus construction, or independent novelty cross-checks against PubMed/Semantic Scholar/OpenAlex.

skills.name: novelty-verification-protocol
skills.trigger_description: Use whenever classifying whether a candidate mechanism/hypothesis is novel (A-E classification) -- the single most safety-critical skill in the system.

skills.name: contradiction-detection
skills.trigger_description: Use when scanning a knowledge graph for direction-conflicting edges on the same node pair, or logging a new contradiction.

skills.name: graph-export-visualization
skills.trigger_description: Use when producing any graph export or visualization (GraphML/GEXF/SVG/PNG, or a filtered subgraph).

skills.name: cross-disease-motif-analysis
skills.trigger_description: Use when comparing two or more disease knowledge graphs to identify shared vs. disease-specific fully-evidenced motifs, generalized to N diseases.

skills.name: canonical-baseline-lookup
skills.trigger_description: Use when fetching already-established, curated mechanistic facts from structured canonical databases (Reactome/KEGG/UniProt/MyDisease.info) before any literature search, to auto-classify known-consensus mechanisms without re-searching the literature every run.
